verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both have the same problems. The white logo band stops abruptly at x≈518 and leaves a strange navy strip above it. The divider rule is moved up beside the CTA, where it floats with no purpose. The body copy is jammed right under the headline and sits off the headline's centre axis, close to the bottom edge. The CTA is pushed out to the right, so the block looks like a fragment and the reading order is broken. The only difference is the logo: A's is a little larger and closer to the original's proportion, while B's is shrunk and looks weaker inside the white band.
